note: These cases are a proposed review checklist, not a supported command line, debug bridge API, automated test suite, or evidence of a result.

common_controls.renderer_rule: Run the three named native renderers where supported and capture the actual backend; conditional Forward+-only cases declare their requirement.
common_controls.shared_pose: Use the same accepted/interpolated pose, selected visual profile, nozzle binding, camera, weather, settings and input tape inside each comparison unless a condition explicitly changes one.
identity_receipt: physical display and actual drawable pixels
common_controls.no_capture_claim: All cases are not_run. Hardware, renderer, scene availability, motion quality and timings remain unverified.

cases.title: Outlet axis and rotated parents
cases.purpose: Validate the smoke -Z to plume +Z adapter on admitted poses and reject unsupported parent transforms.

paired_conditions.description: Identity parent with a validated visual outlet basis.
Rotate the aircraft and parent with a finite, nonsingular, orientation-preserving uniform positive scale; explicitly align local plume +Z with the existing smoke anchor -Z.
Separately introduce nonuniform scale, parent shear, a reflection, zero scale, and an invalid/zero exhaust direction; each is an explicit rejection case.

evidence_expected: For A and B, record world-space origin/direction and side and rear images: +Z points aft, the basis is right-handed, and authored diameter is scaled exactly once.
For each C input, record an actionable validation diagnostic and no guessed, mirrored or wrongly directed flame; do not reinterpret rejection as a successful capture.

cases.title: Side and aft orbit
cases.purpose: Establish visibility across the ordinary camera orbit.

paired_conditions.description: Stable side view 90 degrees to the exhaust direction.
Stable aft and oblique views at 0 and 45 degrees using the same displayed pose and level.

evidence_expected: Matched unedited images and camera matrices show a coherent core, no missing sides or flipped normals.

cases.title: Aft core and root cap
cases.purpose: Check whether the plume looks hollow from behind.

paired_conditions.description: Core and root cap present.
Same frame with cap disabled as a diagnostic control.

evidence_expected: Rear close-up makes the cap contribution and tail occlusion visible; no hollow gap in the selected version.

cases.title: Inside and near-plane views
cases.purpose: Expose near-plane clipping and backface behavior.

paired_conditions.description: Camera just outside the outer plume surface.
Camera just inside the volume and a separate close aft view crossing the near plane.

evidence_expected: Short camera sweep, matrices and near-plane distance; no unexplained full-frame disappearance or inside-out flash.

cases.title: Opaque occlusion
cases.purpose: Verify that the aircraft and terrain can hide the transparent flame.

paired_conditions.description: Tailplane or fuselage placed in front of the plume from the camera.
Terrain ridge placed in front of the same plume with the same exposure and level.

evidence_expected: Images demonstrate normal depth testing, no flame through opaque surfaces, and no unexpected shadow casting.

cases.title: Deformed bounds and screen edge
cases.purpose: Check culling with maximum authored plume dimensions and deformation.

paired_conditions.description: Maximum outer length and radial deformation fully on screen.
Move the nozzle just outside each edge while the maximum plume remains partly visible.

evidence_expected: Maximum local/world bounds and a continuous edge-crossing clip show no premature culling.

cases.title: Layering and blend comparison
cases.purpose: Compare transparent overlap and fragment work between bounded alternatives.

paired_conditions.description: Outer plus inner layer with the proposed blend mode.
One-layer/core-disc candidate or alpha blend with the same pose and displayed level.

evidence_expected: Rear, side and crossing-view images reveal ordering artifacts; record actual draw calls and native timing rather than assuming either wins.

cases.title: Daylight visibility
cases.purpose: Check a restrained plume against the regular bright field and sky.

paired_conditions.description: Daylight environment with the plume off.
Same daylight, camera, accepted pose and visual level one, with plume on.

evidence_expected: Matched captures demonstrate aircraft-attitude readability and visible shape; record exposure and actual internal pixels.

cases.title: Night exposure
cases.purpose: Check that an emissive effect stays recognizable without blowing out the tail.

paired_conditions.description: Night scene with the selected appearance off.
Same night scene with the appearance at level one; retain the existing environment/exposure owner.

evidence_expected: Matched image and exposure record show the tail remains legible, with no uncontrolled white patch.

cases.title: Fog and environment coexistence
cases.purpose: Check presentation through existing weather without replacing world settings.

paired_conditions.description: Clear weather, fixed time and camera.
Existing fog preset or controlled fog density with the same pose, level and exposure policy.

evidence_expected: Fog settings, environment identity and images show expected distance attenuation and unchanged scene ownership.

cases.title: Projected-pixel sweep
cases.purpose: Measure whether nozzle and plume detail survive an RC-scale flight-line view.

paired_conditions.description: D = 0.05 m, vertical FOV 60 degrees, 1080 internal pixels, side view and camera distance 10 m.
Repeat at 20 m and 40 m with the same level; the expected outlet widths are about 4.68, 2.34 and 1.17 pixels.

evidence_expected: Actual internal viewport and measured projected bounding width; unedited images distinguish core visibility from unresolved fine cells.

cases.title: LOD hysteresis
cases.purpose: Check proposed 3-pixel enable and 2-pixel disable boundaries without chatter.

paired_conditions.description: Approach from far to cross projected diameter 3.0 internal pixels; hold the prior state between thresholds.
Recede to cross 2.0 pixels, then jitter around both thresholds with the same presentation tape.

evidence_expected: Frame-by-frame internal footprint and LOD state show one transition per threshold crossing and a persistent low-frequency core.

cases.title: Internal resolution and reconstruction
cases.purpose: Compare native pixels with a lower-resolution reconstruction using the same 1080p output.

paired_conditions.description: Forward+ 1920x1080 native internal resolution with reconstruction off.
Where supported, Forward+ FSR2 Quality at actual 1280x720 internal into 1920x1080 output; otherwise record unsupported.

evidence_expected: Actual scaler execution, effective internal/output dimensions and images; compare LOD decisions using internal pixels.
prerequisites: A supported and verified FSR2 Quality path; do not silently substitute another scaler.

cases.title: Higher output resolution
cases.purpose: Qualify higher resolutions only after the native 1080p baseline.

paired_conditions.description: Native 1920x1080 output and internal pixels.
Repeat at native 2560x1440 and 3840x2160 with the same scene, FOV and visual input.

evidence_expected: Actual drawable/internal sizes and matched field of view; distinguish higher-resolution quality from the first 1080p gate.

cases.title: Restrained RC cell default
cases.purpose: Ensure the first RC profile does not imply an unverified shock-cell pattern.

paired_conditions.description: The default RC profile with cells disabled.
A deliberately enabled cell treatment as an exploratory comparison, clearly marked non-default.

evidence_expected: Profile settings and matched capture confirm the default has no cells; any proposed alternative remains art-only.

cases.title: Reference cell stationarity
cases.purpose: Check that reference-study cells stay fixed to the nozzle while turbulence moves.

paired_conditions.description: Reference profile with weak cells enabled; record two times one second apart.
Same snapshots with cells disabled to isolate their contribution.

evidence_expected: Nozzle-relative axial cell positions remain fixed as detail changes; distant filtering removes unresolved contrast.
Label images full-scale reference study and not RC calibration.
Fixed peak positions verify this proposed shader behavior, not physical stationarity or RC shock-cell measurements.

cases.title: Cosmetic LED isolation
cases.purpose: Confirm the decorative ring is an independent visual presentation.

paired_conditions.description: LED level one with no plume profile.
LED level zero, then an RC plume as a separately selected illustrative comparison.

evidence_expected: LED-only image contains a ring and no gas mesh, particles or haze; record separate signal and unchanged physical state.

cases.title: Light-off, hold and cutoff
cases.purpose: Check a smooth, bounded appearance response to accepted levels.

paired_conditions.description: Presented visual-level tape 0 to 0.15 to 0.5 to 1.0, then hold.
Matched tape from 1.0 back to zero; no new births after the visual cutoff.

evidence_expected: Timeline clip and timestamped input/uniform record show coherent length/brightness, no visible pre-ignition, and a defined extinction.

cases.title: Pause and resume
cases.purpose: Verify that visual animation follows the presented simulation clock.

paired_conditions.description: Hold a lit paused snapshot for five wall-clock seconds.
Resume from the same snapshot and advance one accepted presentation interval.

evidence_expected: Before/after shader phase, displayed pose and frames remain unchanged during pause and continue on resume.

cases.title: Long-time phase wrap
cases.purpose: Prevent wrapped-angle interpolation from jumping at long session times.

paired_conditions.description: Evaluate unwrapped presentation times 1023.999, 1024.000 and 1024.001 seconds.
Evaluate the midpoint from interpolated unwrapped time, not an average of wrapped radians.

evidence_expected: CPU reference phase inputs and captures show continuity at the wrap; report GPU variance separately.

cases.title: Seek, restart and teleport
cases.purpose: Clear history instead of drawing a streak across a discontinuity.

paired_conditions.description: Continuous accepted motion into a short lit segment.
Seek backward, restart and separately teleport, then prime the new pose before births resume.

evidence_expected: Timestamp, pool and event history show no stale pre-reset frame, duplicate burst or bridge across the discontinuity.

cases.title: Frame-rate motion
cases.purpose: Inspect temporal sampling and flicker at common rendering rates.

paired_conditions.description: Same accepted presentation tape captured at 60 displayed frames/s.
Repeat at 30 and 20 displayed frames/s with identical camera and render settings.

evidence_expected: Motion clips, frame timestamps and phase inputs permit review for strobing or apparent reversal; state whether frame caps were honored.

cases.title: Particle straight-line sweep
cases.purpose: Check fractional world-space births during rapid translation.

paired_conditions.description: Optional detail disabled, with the mesh core retained.
Optional detail enabled while the outlet moves at 40 m/s and 30 displayed frames/s; use swept births.

evidence_expected: Motion and birthplace overlays show rearward emission without a 1.33 m endpoint-only gap or doubled carrier velocity.
prerequisites: A future optional particle adapter using the accepted presentation clock; no manual Compatibility emission.

cases.title: Particle rotation and antipodes
cases.purpose: Check outlet rotation and velocity ownership.

paired_conditions.description: Fixed-orientation outlet translating at the same speed.
A turn plus a separate 180-degree direction-change fixture, retaining one carrier-velocity owner.

evidence_expected: Birth directions stay finite and aft relative to each interpolated nozzle pose; record tangential outlet motion and no doubled inheritance.
prerequisites: A future optional particle adapter and captured transformed outlet poses.

cases.title: Particle cutoff and residual life
cases.purpose: Check the distinction between stopping births and aging existing detail.

paired_conditions.description: Cutoff immediately after a burst with 0.25 s maximum illustrative life.
Resume only after a fresh accepted positive visual level; repeat across pause.

evidence_expected: Event/birth log and clip show no new cutoff births, bounded residual expiry, pause freeze and no unintended stale replay.

cases.title: Capacity and scheduler overflow
cases.purpose: Check bounded pool demand and explicit failure instead of silent event loss.

paired_conditions.description: Illustrative 16-slot pool and 0.25 s lifetime: request 48 births/s, or 12 nominal live slots.
With the same pool, request 120 births/s and inspect saturation and any explicitly resolved rate.

Separately, on the existing public scheduler, compare an inclusive 24-tick interval with 25 tick positions against invalid inputs: a 25-tick interval or an array of 26 input changes; reset after a latched failure.

Only through a deliberately owned consumer test seam or future AB adapter, inject 32 versus 33 raw event records into the 32-record consumer capacity; do not imply the current scheduler naturally generates 33.

evidence_expected: Record requested/resolved rate, pool occupancy and saturation; do not assume an unimplemented GPU adapter achieves any particular count.
Record public-path interval and input-bound rejections, with the fault latched until reset. The current inclusive loop can produce at most 25 output records per slot over an accepted interval.

For a separately injected consumer-boundary test, distinguish 32-record capacity from overflow at 33, verify the latched fault without silent truncation, and identify the test seam. No guard has been exercised yet.
prerequisites: A future detail adapter; a disposable existing-scheduler test for public input boundaries; and a separately owned raw-event consumer seam for injected capacity tests.

cases.title: Noise seams and mip filtering
cases.purpose: Check the reusable data texture at wrapping boundaries and oblique sizes.

paired_conditions.description: Show the shared noise across the angular wrap at full-resolution sampling.
Repeat at oblique angles and progressively coarser mip levels, including the plume tip.

evidence_expected: Texture-state record and seam crops reveal no obvious line, inverted tip or distant shimmer; compare value and slope across the wrap.

cases.title: Scalar versus color interpretation
cases.purpose: Catch accidental sRGB conversion of masks or double conversion of authored colors.

paired_conditions.description: Known 0.5 scalar test patch sampled as linear data.
A known sRGB color patch converted once to the renderer working space; compare in all supported renderers.

evidence_expected: Numeric sampled values, import flags and an exposure-controlled capture identify unintended conversion; do not interpret a screenshot alone as linear pixel data.
prerequisites: A future diagnostic patch with known values; no external asset is required.

cases.title: Cold and warm resource readiness
cases.purpose: Find first-use stalls and unsafe noise-readback assumptions.

paired_conditions.description: Fresh process, request selected noise once and wait for tracked successful readiness.
Reuse the same prepared immutable texture for another outlet and a warm relight.

evidence_expected: Record preparation duration, actual texture/resource identity and readiness errors; distinguish synchronous initial work from later worker updates.
No null-only 3D data guard or unbounded wait; 3D path is only relevant if trialed.

cases.title: Two-outlet isolation
cases.purpose: Ensure shared immutable assets do not couple independently controlled outlets.

paired_conditions.description: Outlet A level zero, outlet B level one.
Change A to one while holding B fixed, then change B to zero while holding A fixed.

evidence_expected: Per-outlet IDs, material/texture identities, uniform values and side-by-side frames show independent changes with shared immutable texture only.

cases.title: Main and auxiliary viewports
cases.purpose: Check independent view-dependent LOD and no duplicate state advancement.

paired_conditions.description: Main 1080p viewport alone at a close aft angle.
Main plus an available auxiliary viewport at a distant or oblique angle; use the same presented state.

evidence_expected: Record each actual viewport size, camera, LOD state and rendered frame; confirm correct per-view culling and no doubled timeline or particle updates.
prerequisites: An actual available auxiliary viewport; if unavailable, record not supported rather than inventing an API.

cases.title: Lake reflection and transparency
cases.purpose: Check visual consistency where the experimental planar reflection path is actually available.

paired_conditions.description: Lake planar reflection disabled in the same scene.
Experimental planar reflection enabled if the selected native Forward+ path and aircraft reflection are supported; otherwise record unavailable.

evidence_expected: Record reflection mode, actual reflected layers, images and timing; distinguish absent supported aircraft reflection from an afterburner bug.
prerequisites: A real supported experimental planar-lake path; no promise that transparent flame is reflected.

cases.title: Effects Off lifecycle
cases.purpose: Check allocations and physical independence across repeated effects toggles.

paired_conditions.description: Start a fresh session with global Effects Off before any AB presentation resource is allocated.
Enable effects, select the appearance and warm its resources on the same accepted state/tape.
Turn effects Off, allow deferred cleanup, and repeat On/Off cycles without changing the accepted physical input.

evidence_expected: At initial Off, no AB-owned effect node, mesh, material, noise texture, particle pool, light or haze is allocated and no AB updates run.
After each On to Off transition, AB-owned resources are released and updates suspended; report separately any immutable cache owned or still needed by another system.
Physical state and trajectory remain unchanged by the presentation choice.

cases.title: Paired native performance
cases.purpose: Estimate the visual cost against the proposed combined +0.5 ms frame-p95 allocation.

paired_conditions.description: After a 10 s warmup, seven alternating completed 60 s pairs with the same flight tape and visuals off.
Same seven pairs with the selected visual tier on; separately ablate optional layers.

evidence_expected: Report per-pair p95(on)-p95(off), median/range, GPU/driver, renderer, caps, effective dimensions, 0.99-1.01 simulation/wall ratio and at least 95% intended on activity.
Call the result inconclusive if caps, noise, missed activity or incomplete pairs prevent a defensible comparison.
prerequisites: Named native target hardware, a complete future AB-equipped flight and an idle host; no screenshots/readbacks during timing.
